decisions.reason: The field clauses did not explicitly lift the fixed component vectors to tangent vectors at every field point. The inertial chart provides a canonical constant extension, so this is a nonfatal typing omission. Clause (d) now gives n_q=n^a partial_a|_q and s_q=s^a partial_a|_q on a specified open domain, and specifies smooth symmetric tensor fields. Clause (c) extends screen dual covectors by e^i(v)=eta(e_i,v), making the ambient reconstruction well typed. Normalization, projections and amplitudes are unchanged.

The opening supplier restatement calls n=du the wave covector although the supplier calls k=-omega n the wave covector. This is nonfatal terminology: clause (a), the proof and the Remark already distinguish both objects and give the correct signs. Changed only the opening name to the differential of the phase coordinate; also parenthesized (partial_3 u)^2 and stated partial_3^2 u=0 in proof 2.1 to remove an ambiguous derivative expression.

L1 omitted the X in V_0 hypothesis of the unique-TT-representative supplier. The proposed diagonal counterexample has Z=0 and trace one, confirming that the unconditional restatement is false. This is nonfatal for the example: step 1.1 already checks all four harmonic contractions for the actual matrix, so the supplier applies. Repaired L1 with X in V_0 and omega nonzero, and made step 2.1 explicitly use and cite step 1.1; the matrix, representative and gauge transformation are unchanged.

The fourth datum bullet explicitly binds g(lambda):=eta+lambda h; it does not assert equality with the metric of the supplied tuple (epsilon_1,h,q). The latter may have nonzero q. The extra Lorentzian requirement is on the newly defined truncated metric near K, and D explicitly evaluates G(eta+lambda h), so its cosmological term and Einstein tensor use the same metric. All detector formulas use that same local binding. First-order coefficients depend only on h, not q, by the flat coefficient formulas. No hypothesis requires the original remainder-bearing family to be the detector metric. The rejection conflates two locally defined uses of g; no item edit is justified.

With Box=-partial_0^2+partial_3^2 on these profiles, both second derivatives are -omega^2 f, so the time and spatial contributions are +omega^2 f and -omega^2 f. L1 displayed them in the reverse order. The scalar equality was still zero (the judge overstates its falsity), and neither harmonicity nor the curvature and strain calculations fail; this is a nonfatal sign-decomposition defect. Repaired L1 by giving both second derivatives and the correctly signed Box formula for cosine and sine. L2 now also explicitly retains the zero-profile branch rather than writing 1/(2M) without M>0.
